toolParams.sql:
WITH top5 AS (
    SELECT fitemidcode
    FROM fne_paybook_full_high
    GROUP BY fitemidcode
    ORDER BY SUM(famt) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
bus AS (
    SELECT
        p.fitemidcode AS item_id,
        p.fitemname AS item_name,
        p.fbustype AS bustype,
        count() AS row_cnt,
        SUM(p.famt) AS amt,
        uniqExact(p.fid) AS cnt_fid
    FROM fne_paybook_full_high AS p
    WHERE p.fitemidcode IN top5
    GROUP BY item_id, item_name, bustype
),
names AS (
    SELECT
        item_id,
        argMax(item_name, row_cnt) AS item_name,
        groupUniqArray(item_name) AS all_names
    FROM bus
    GROUP BY item_id
)
SELECT
    b.item_id AS item_id,
    n.item_name AS item_name,
    n.all_names AS all_names,
    round(SUM(b.amt), 2) AS amt_total,
    round(sumIf(b.amt, b.bustype = '1'), 2) AS amt_direct,
    round(sumIf(b.amt, b.bustype = '2'), 2) AS amt_agg,
    sumIf(b.cnt_fid, b.bustype = '1') AS cnt_direct,
    sumIf(b.cnt_fid, b.bustype = '2') AS cnt_agg
FROM bus AS b
INNER JOIN names AS n ON b.item_id = n.item_id
GROUP BY b.item_id, n.item_name, n.all_names
ORDER BY amt_total DESC
